name: Prayer and the church as mental health support
what_people_do: Turn to prayer, scripture, the pastor or the congregation when distressed, instead of or before therapy.
why_they_say_it_works: God is a source of strength; church is trusted, free and close.

documented_by.source: Taylor RJ et al 2021, Soc Work Public Health, PMID 33378231 (National Survey of American Life)
documented_by.quote_or_summary: National Survey of American Life: three in four African Americans and Black Caribbeans with a 12-month psychiatric disorder used prayer to cope; prayer especially important with generalised anxiety.

evidence.finding: Religious-based interventions gave superior effects to usual therapies; trials varied widely.

source.name: Religious-based interventions for depression, meta-analysis of RCTs, 2022, J Affect Disord, PMID 35500682

harm_note: Positive as support; risk is when prayer replaces treatment for severe illness.
